summary: Beasley Broadcast Group filed an 8-K disclosing a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement to a single institutional investor. The company sold 200,000 Class A shares at $14.00 and pre-funded warrants for 157,000 shares at $13.9999, plus common warrants for 357,000 shares, exercisable in six months. The pre-funded warrants carry a $0.0001 strike and no expiration. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes; no advisor, premium, or board recommendation is named. Watch for dilution and warrant overhang, plus any resale registration and price pressure.
